name: NewWave Media
description: Discover free-to-access movies and English-language live TV with NewWave Media, a browser-based player for local files, authorized streaming URLs and M3U playlists.
facts: NewWave Media is a mobile-first browser media player. Main navigation: Live, Add URL, Open File, Queue. USA channel discovery starts automatically; English-language directory is selectable. Community IPTV-org entries are tested for three seconds of advancing video before being shown as playable; results expire and are rechecked. Playback is not proof of broadcasting authorization or country availability. Local video and audio files stay on the device; playback uses object URLs. Supports direct HTTPS media URLs, M3U channel playlists, native HLS or HLS.js, SRT/VTT captions, queue, shuffle, repeat, resume, speed, picture fit, fullscreen and picture-in-picture where supported. Internet Archive film discovery screens rights metadata; Blender open films have attribution links. NewWave itself requires no account or subscription. External services may require accounts or subscriptions. No hosting of third-party movies, DRM or geographic bypass. Individual external channel rights and live playback in Lebanon and UAE remain unverified. Live opens with a visible player and compact channel selector. The first locally validated channel is attempted with muted autoplay. Playlist imports are in Add URL, and movies are collapsed by default.
